audit_items.proof_trace: Token is generated via Node.js `crypto.randomUUID()` (RFC 4122 v4, 122-bit CSPRNG entropy), imported directly from 'crypto' with no polyfill. Uniqueness is enforced at the database level by a UNIQUE index `temp_registrations_qr_token_key` on `attendance.temp_registrations.qr_token` (migration 0001:63). All alternative generation paths (actions-new.ts, actions.ts.backup) also use `crypto.randomUUID()` exclusively.
